campuses.name: California Schoolyard Tree Canopy Equity Study, Green Schoolyards America with GreenInfo Network and California Department of Education school data

fields.studentZoneCanopyPct: StPct: reported percent tree canopy in student-use zones
fields.propertyCanopyPct: PropPct: reported tree canopy percent across the entire property
fields.sourceEnrollment: CpTotEnr23: source-reported enrollment; the field suffix is retained and not recast as current enrollment
fields.sourceMealsEligibilityPct: FPct: source-reported percent qualifying for free or reduced-price meals; optional context only, not used to rank schools
fields.coordinates: Source campus point in longitude, latitude order

campuses.studyVintage: 2024 study layer; source imagery acquisition date is not specified in the service metadata

weatherForecast.name: Open-Meteo Weather Forecast API
weatherForecast.meaning: Live seven-day daily maximum air-temperature forecast for the weather grid cell nearest the selected campus coordinates

fields.location: selected campus coordinates; forecast grid-cell center returned by service

limitations: Campus canopy is a study estimate; it is not a real-time shade audit, temperature reading, or verified intervention opportunity.
Student-zone and whole-property canopy describe different footprints and must not be subtracted to infer usable canopy area.
Campus-area weather is a live model-grid forecast, not a schoolyard temperature, heat-health rating, or seasonal climate projection.
